assessment_effects.baseline_state: Comfort Systems USA presents an exceptional balance sheet ($1.80B net cash) and high capital returns (>28% ROIC), supported by multi-year modular HVAC backlogs for hyperscale data center construction. However, the frozen reference market price of $1439.07 embeds a demanding 30.07% 5-year revenue CAGR at elevated 15.0% operating margins. Retained on watch: await market pullback toward mid-cycle base valuation range ($1,050 - $1,100) or evidence of margin persistence.
assessment_effects.draft_state: Net cash reserves expanded to $2108.5M while TTM revenue grew to $12.54B at 16.70% operating margin. Solved 5-year revenue CAGR holding 15.0% margin and 9.5% WACC fixed shifted from 30.07% to 26.76%. Market reference price ($1439.07) remains above base intrinsic value ($1215.00). Core decisive thesis (await pullback toward modeled value or evidence of margin persistence) is maintained.
assessment_effects.notes: Operational metrics updated from primary filing facts; required growth eased but remains above historical trend.

disposition_rationale: Proposed disposition: MAINTAIN Quality Watch status (WATCH_CONDITIONS). Operational results in Q3 2026 expanded net cash buffer to $2108.5M and eased solved reverse-DCF CAGR to 26.76%. However, reference market price ($1439.07) remains above mid-cycle base intrinsic value ($1215.00), and core hyperscale cyclicality remains unresolvable. No thesis invalidation occurred; maintain watch status pending human Research Lead review.
questions_requiring_owner_judgment: Base modeled value shifted from $1081.99 to $1215.00 (+12.3%). Does the Research Lead / Product Owner approve updating the price watch entry corridor, or should existing ($1,050 - $1,100) thresholds remain unchanged?
Should normalized operating margin assumption (15.0%) be reassessed at the next annual research review given sustained 16.70% trailing 12-month margin execution?
stopping_rule: Evidence collection complete for Form 10-Q (Period: 2026-09-30). All reported primary facts reconciled and conditional valuation differences calculated. Core customer capex cycle uncertainty remains an evidence limitation that cannot be further resolved via SEC quarterly filings until FY2026 Form 10-K. Cease investigation.
